thread:
qian: quick heads-up — we reproduced a small embeddings regression during heavy tail batching. I've got a tiny hotfix ready (model-embed v2.5.0-quickfix). Requesting an expedited traffic-shift in the 03:45-03:50 UTC window.

omar: can you drop the exact command you want run and the rollback criteria?

qian: command: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.5.0-quickfix --strategy traffic-shift --steps 2,20,100 --no-canary --note "hotfix: eviction backoff + retry windows"`

infra_oncall: thumbs-up to fast lane if we have clear rollback gates. what are the triggers?

qian: rollback if embed_error_rate > 1% sustained for 4m OR vector_mismatch_rate > 0.8% OR p95 latency increases by >180ms. Also watch tokenization errors per-host.

deploybot: Deploybot: deploy slot available at 03:46 UTC. To proceed run the pinned command. Confirmers required: @pam @infra_oncall.

pam: i can approve. paste a 1-line release blurb and i'll post changelog.

chris: quick preflight: `http POST https://int-smoke/embed/smoke version=v2.5.0-quickfix samples=250` -> 0/250 errors, vector_mismatch_rate=0.15%, p95=138ms (baseline 140ms). good to go.

pam: approving expedited traffic-shift for 03:46 slot. @infra_oncall will hold rollback.

qian: starting at 03:46. plan: very small 2% start to validate tail behavior, then 20%, then 100%. tight watches and automatic rollback if thresholds tripped.

deploybot: Started traffic-shift at 03:46 UTC. Steps: 2% -> 20% -> 100%. Monitoring hooks: embed_error_rate, vector_mismatch_rate, p95_latency, token_errors. Live page: https://deploys.internal/4212349876

infra_oncall: 2% step healthy. no spike in errors. p95 ~139ms.

chris: 20% step in progress. seeing a short tokenization error spike on one AZ (node ip:10.2.5.12). looks localized.

qian: pause rollout at 20%. do an autoscaler recycle on the noisy host, then resume. do not proceed to 100% until token_errors clear.

deploybot: Pausing rollout at 20% per operator request. Triggering autoscaler replace for instance 10.2.5.12.

infra_oncall: replaced noisy instance, health checks passed. token_errors back to baseline.

deploybot: Resuming rollout to 100% at 03:49 UTC.

infra_oncall: 100% reached. post-deploy 6m metrics: embed_error_rate=0.3%, vector_mismatch_rate=0.2%, p95_latency=142ms. token_errors normalized. No rollback needed. :white_check_mark:

chris: running a quick quality sweep across top 10 customers' flows — looks stable.

pam: release blurb: "v2.5.0-quickfix: fixes eviction timing under tail batches to reduce embedding failures; applied traffic-shift hotfix." I'll publish to changelog and customer digest.

releasebot: Releasebot: changelog entry published: "2026-03-23 — v2.5.0-quickfix: eviction backoff to address tail-burst embedding regressions."

qian: thanks team. filing a follow-up to add vector_mismatch_rate to preflight smoke checks and to add a synthetic tail-split test to CI. closing loop.
